data.content:
## Team News

Celta Vigo quartet Borja Iglesias (calf), Carl Starfelt, Manuel Sanchez (both hamstring) and Miguel Roman (knee) are all doubtful with injuries and will be assessed ahead of kickoff.

Ferran Jutgla and Iago Aspas are both contenders to earn recalls in attack, with the former set to battle with Pablo Duran for the centre-forward spot and the latter to rival Hugo Alvarez for a place on the right side of a front three. [...] Former Chelsea and Barcelona defender Marcos Alonso, 35, is expected to continue on the left side of a three-man defence next to Yoel Lago and Javi Rodriguez, while Javi Rueda and Sergio Carreira could both start as wing-backs with Ilaix Moriba and Aleix Febas linking arms in midfield.

As for Bournemouth, they will be without Alex Toth, Julian Araujo (both thigh) and Juanlu Sanchez (ankle) as they continue to recover from injuries. [...] Celta Vigo possible starting lineup:

Radu; Rodriguez, Yago, Alonso; Rueda, Moriba, Febas, Carreira; Aspas, Jutgla, Swedberg

Bournemouth possible starting lineup:

Di Gregorio; Smith, Hill, Diakite, Soler; Cook, Christie; Rayan, Adli, Tavernier; Kroupi
